query:
-- who tapped? Links the chip to an account that is waiting for one
-- (pair_until in the future), otherwise finds the owner by chip uid or
-- APP-<username>. Always returns exactly one row.
WITH paired AS (
  UPDATE app_users SET rfid_uid = $1, pair_until = NULL
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM app_users WHERE pair_until > now() ORDER BY pair_until DESC LIMIT 1)
    AND $1 NOT LIKE 'APP-%'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_users WHERE rfid_uid = $1)
  RETURNING id, display_name, true AS paired
), known AS (
  SELECT id, display_name, false AS paired FROM app_users
  WHERE rfid_uid = $1 OR 'APP-' || username = $1
), who AS (
  SELECT * FROM paired UNION ALL SELECT * FROM known LIMIT 1
)
SELECT w.id AS user_id, w.display_name, coalesce(w.paired, false) AS paired,
       (SELECT s.slot FROM parking_sessions s
         WHERE s.status = 'parked' AND (s.uid = $1 OR s.user_id = w.id)
         ORDER BY s.parked_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS parked_slot
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN who w ON true;
